test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The group of islands which form part of India and lie to the southeast of Indian mainland in Bay of Bengal is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Andaman and Nicobar Islands__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are located in the Bay of Bengal, **southeast of the Indian mainland**.
 
• There are **numerous beaches** on the island, which draw vacationers.
 
• The capital of Andaman and Nicobar Islands is **Port Blair**.
 
• The **Indira Point** on the island of Andaman & Nicobar is where India's **southernmost point** is situated.
 
• [IMAGE: https://drishtiias.com/images/uploads/1669116442_Sothernmost_Drishti_AIS_English.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lakshadweep islands: **An archipelago of 36 islands called Lakshadweep islands is made up of the Arabian Sea, 200 to 440 kilometres off the **Malabar Coast.**
 
• **Mannar island:** Mannar Island, which is a part of **Sri Lanka**'s Mannar District, is located off the country's **northwestern coast.**
 
• **Maldives islands:** A sovereign island nation called The Maldives is located in the **north-central Indian Ocean.**
